_howto: Guided setup for Production Pay (Demo / Setup mode). checks = what the data must show; confirm = the user confirms.
title: Set up Production Pay
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo, so nothing affects your live system until you push it. Each step checks itself against what you've set up.

steps.title: Farms and field units
steps.why: Where the work happens. Tasks are given for farms and their units, and the phones and Field Maps use their GPS locations.
steps.todo: At least one active farm with an active field unit.

steps.title: Global rules
steps.why: Rules for everyone: whether people can be in more than one team, overtime, whether piecework hours come off normal time, the Global Hourly Rate, and where job costing departments come from.

steps.title: Activities and their rates
steps.why: What people are paid for, the unit it's counted in, and the rate. New rates go in the Pricing Ledger with the date they start, so past days keep their rate.
steps.todo: At least one active activity with a rate.

steps.title: Job costing activities
steps.why: Jobs people clock time against on the mobile app, such as Irrigation or Maintenance.
steps.todo: At least one active job costing activity.

steps.title: Production teams
steps.why: Who works together, who manages them, and how the manager is paid on team work.
steps.todo: At least one active team with members.

steps.title: Payroll periods
steps.why: The cycles people are paid on; locked periods can't be changed in Daily Production. They're set up in Employee Master › Payroll Periods (the link is on this tab).
steps.todo: At least one payroll period, with every active employee on one.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Tasks: create a task for your team (Show me how on the Tasks screen).
  2. Daily Production: load the team's day, type in quantities, check their pay, then Commit to Payroll.
  3. See it on the Production Dashboard and in a Production Report.
Tasks and production are never pushed to live.
